functional_chain: Passed: real reader -> persistent page/version/chunk/source -> exact selected page -> isolated preview -> real shared production views and explicit fallbacks.
boundaries: No OCR or highlight on invalid requested pages; empty/missing/repeated passages and invalid native bounds fall back. The native prefix only aligns a complete persisted passage; regions come from actual OCR substring geometry.
resources_concurrency: The existing bounded helper/lease owns PDFKit, Vision and source bytes. No new persistent tasks, connections, caches or handles. Existing context/file cleanup and loader/controller generations are retained.
security: No shell execution, URLs, network or untrusted paths added. Only current-version pdf-ocr evidence enables the on-demand location option. No source-format parsing added in host.
consistency: PDF location uses existing imageTextLocated state for shared immediate pixel retirement and localized fallback; documented expanded semantics. No indexing/schema/recipe/model changes.
